entries.jp: そのかわり、一年中、畑を耕しているような‥‥。

entries.jp: あはは‥‥。

entries.jp: うんうん、丈夫に育ってんな。

When you need to{n}heal in a hurry, items are handier. You can use 'em{n}right away.{p}So when you see some for sale, stock up.

entries.en: ...Sigh, I guess it can't be helped... You can't expect a{n}little kid like that to understand...

entries.jp: ううう‥‥どうしよう‥‥。{n}まさか、例の怪物が現れるなんて‥‥。
entries.en: Ugh... What do I do... I never thought that monster{n}would show up...

entries.jp: ああ、これはこれはサンドラ様の‥‥。
entries.en: Ah, well, if it isn't Sandra-sama's...

entries.jp: あの、どうかしたんですか？
entries.en: Um, is something wrong?

entries.jp: ええ、まぁ‥‥。{n}実はさっきの子供はですね、{n}先の闇落としで両親を亡くしてしまいまして‥‥。{p}ですが、まだ両親が死んでしまったことを{n}理解できてないんですよ。
entries.en: Yes, well... The truth is, that child just now lost his{n}parents in the recent Darkfall...{p}But he still doesn't understand that his parents{n}are dead.

entries.jp: ああ、これはこれはサンドラ様の‥‥。{p}さっきの子供はですね、{n}先の闇落としで両親を亡くしてしまいまして‥‥。{p}ですが、まだ両親が死んでしまったことを{n}理解できてないんですよ。
entries.en: Ah, well, if it isn't Sandra-sama's...{p}That child just now lost his parents in the{n}recent Darkfall...{p}But he still doesn't understand that his parents{n}are dead.

entries.jp: それで、１人で村に‥‥。
entries.en: So that's why he went into the village alone...

entries.jp: ええ。{n}まだこの村のどこかに、{n}両親がいると思いこんでるみたいでして‥‥。
entries.en: Yes. He seems convinced his parents are still{n}somewhere in this village...

entries.jp: そうだったんだ。{n}かわいそうだね‥‥。
entries.en: So that's what happened. Poor thing...

entries.jp: 私も胸が痛みますよ。{n}でも後は、あの子の気が済むようにさせてあげるしか{n}ないでしょうね‥‥。
entries.en: It pains me too. But all we can do now is let him keep{n}at it until he's satisfied, I suppose...

entries.jp: うわああああっ！
entries.en: Waaaaaah!

entries.jp: ん、なんだ！？
entries.en: Hm? What was that?!

entries.jp: た、大変だ！{n}闇落としの時の化け物が‥‥！
entries.en: Th-this is bad! The monster from the Darkfall...!

entries.jp: えええっ！？{n}それじゃ、さっき村に入っていった子供は！？
entries.en: Whaaat?! Then what about the kid who went into the{n}village just now?!

entries.jp: 子供は、残った仲間たちが何とか守っているが‥‥。{n}とにかく、これ以上は誰も通すな！
entries.en: The others who stayed behind are protecting the kid{n}somehow, but... Anyway, don't let anyone else through!

entries.jp: オレは村に戻って、あの化け物を何とかする！
entries.en: I'm going back to the village to deal with that monster!

entries.jp: あっ、ちょっと！{n}危ないよ！
entries.en: Ah, hey, wait! It's dangerous!

entries.jp: ‥‥行っちゃった‥‥。{n}どうしよう？
entries.en: ...He's gone... What do we do?

entries.jp: 闇落としの化け物って、{n}ユングみたいなヤツだよね？
entries.en: A monster from the Darkfall... That means something like{n}Jung, right?

entries.jp: ああ。{n}ただの警備兵には荷が重過ぎる相手だぞ。
entries.en: Yeah. Way too much for an ordinary guard to handle.

entries.jp: このまま放っておけないよ、お兄ちゃん！
entries.en: We can't just leave them, Big Brother!

entries.jp: ねぇ、お兄ちゃん。{n}何があったのか気になるし、{n}話だけでも聞いてみようよ。
entries.en: Hey, Big Brother. I'm curious about what happened.{n}Let's at least go and hear what they have to say.
